description:
Please plug in charger to OTA upgrade when power is lower than 50%.

Update Version:
LK7k-16.3.0.160SP02(OP002PF001AZ)

Changed Functions:
1. Updated Google Security Patch to October 5, 2026, fixing related vulnerabilities and improving system security.

Fixed Issues:
1. Improved animation smoothness when opening the Recent album, making page transitions smoother.
2. Improved animation smoothness when exiting home screen edit mode.
3. Improved responsiveness and animation smoothness when swiping down to open AI Search after unlocking.
4. Fixed the issue where apps could occasionally restart unexpectedly when multiple apps were kept running in the background, improving background stability.
5. Fixed the issue where the home screen data plan widget would occasionally fail to update the remaining data after mobile data was used.
6. Fixed the issue where the incoming call pop-up would not appear at the top of the screen when the screen was on, making calls easier to answer.
7. Improved Find My Phone location accuracy by reducing positioning deviation.
8. Fixed the issue where ringtones could revert to the default after a system update. Custom alarm ringtones now remain unchanged after updates.
9. Fixed the issue in the Recorder app where recording files could occasionally be lost after the screen turned off and the phone was later unlocked. Recordings are now saved more reliably.

Reminding:
1. Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
2. Visit the TECNO SPOT forum (https://tspot.tecno.com) for more information.
